Pattern library

Candlestick and chart patterns describe how price tends to behave in certain conditions. None of them proves a direction on its own; each points to a possibility.

At MarketLevelMap we read patterns together with support and resistance zones. Where a pattern forms matters as much as what it is: the same candle can mean something at a zone and little in open space.

  • Bullish Engulfing

    Yutan Boğa

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a decline, when a large green candle completely engulfs the body of the previous red candle.

  • Bearish Engulfing

    Yutan Ayı

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 2 candles

    A reversal pattern that forms after a rise, when a large red candle completely engulfs the body of the previous green candle.

  • Hammer

    Çekiç

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline, with a small body and a long lower wick.

  • Inverted Hammer

    Ters Çekiç

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline, with a small body and a long upper wick.

  • Shooting Star

    Kayan Yıldız

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise, with a small body and a long upper wick.

  • Pin Bar

    • Candlestick pattern
    • Reversal either way
    • Single candle

    A single-candle reversal pattern made of one long wick and a small body.

  • Doji

    • Candlestick pattern
    • Indecision
    • Single candle

    A single candle whose open and close are almost the same, leaving a very small body.

  • Morning Star

    Sabah Yıldızı

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • 3 candles

    A three-candle reversal pattern that forms after a decline.

  • Evening Star

    Akşam Yıldızı

    • Candlestick pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • 3 candles

    A three-candle reversal pattern that forms after a rise.

  • Head and Shoulders

    Omuz Baş Omuz (OBO)

    • Chart pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Multi-candle

    A reversal pattern that forms at the end of an uptrend and is made of three peaks.

  • Inverse Head and Shoulders

    Ters Omuz Baş Omuz (TOBO)

    • Chart pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Multi-candle

    A reversal pattern that forms at the end of a downtrend and is made of three troughs.

  • Double Top

    İkili Tepe

    • Chart pattern
    • ↓ Bearish reversal
    • Multi-candle

    A reversal pattern that forms at the end of an uptrend, when price makes two peaks at roughly the same level.

  • Double Bottom

    İkili Dip

    • Chart pattern
    • ↑ Bullish reversal
    • Multi-candle

    A reversal pattern that forms at the end of a downtrend, when price makes two troughs at roughly the same level.

  • Ascending Triangle

    Yükselen Üçgen

    • Chart pattern
    • ↑ Bullish continuation
    • Multi-candle

    A triangle pattern formed by a flat resistance line and a series of rising lows.

  • Descending Triangle

    Alçalan Üçgen

    • Chart pattern
    • ↓ Bearish continuation
    • Multi-candle

    A triangle pattern formed by a flat support line and a series of falling highs.

  • Symmetrical Triangle

    Simetrik Üçgen

    • Chart pattern
    • Continuation with the trend
    • Multi-candle

    A triangle pattern formed by lower highs and higher lows converging on each other.

  • Flag

    Bayrak

    • Chart pattern
    • Continuation with the trend
    • Multi-candle

    A continuation pattern that forms when a sharp, fast move (the pole) is followed by a short pause in a narrow channel sloping against that move.

  • Pennant

    Flama

    • Chart pattern
    • Continuation with the trend
    • Multi-candle

    A short pause that forms after a sharp, fast move (the pole) and is made of two small, converging lines.
